name: eca-audit-monorepo
description: Monorepo de control de auditoría RDP - ECA Soluciones

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix dashboard && npm install --prefix license-server && npm install --prefix license-admin
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix dashboard" "npm run worker:dev --prefix dashboard" "npm start --prefix license-server" "npm run dev --prefix license-admin"
